verses.1: Therefore, they must bear all kinds of evils, as well as all forms of deception, mockery, slander, and all kinds of insults.
verses.2: Just as a baby needs solid milk to grow and develop towards salvation, so too does the human mind need nourishment from reason in order to grow and develop toward salvation.
verses.3: If you have thought that it is useful, then the Lord is useful.
verses.4: To whom we approach, living as stones, despised by humans, but chosen by God and worthy of respect.
verses.5: And they, living like stones, built a spiritual house that could be used as a holy place for worship. They offered spiritual sacrifices to God through Jesus Christ.
verses.6: For it contains these words: “Behold, I have set up a stone pillar in Zion; and whoever believes in it will not be condemned.”
verses.7: So, this is the honor for those who believe. But those who built this structure failed to understand that what they created became a “head” for the angles.
verses.8: And there were also stones and rocks that stood in the way; they tried to block the path of the message. And they were destroyed by those stones and rocks.
verses.9: We, however, are a chosen race, a people who serve the temple as priests. We are a holy nation, a people destined to be preserved and protected, so that our virtues may be brought forth from darkness, and we may be called upon to enter into His wonderful light.
verses.10: Who are these people who are not considered “people” now? And who are those who are not honored now but will be honored in the future?
verses.11: Beloved ones, I urge you to stay away from those physical desires. They are those that are controlled by the soul.
verses.12: May this transformation among your nations be good. In it, they will be able to praise the Lord on the day of judgment, while they also realize that from good deeds, they can glorify God.
verses.13: You should guide all human beings in their construction through the Lord’s will; whether they are kings or not.
verses.14: Whether they are praised as those who are used for vindication in trials, or as those who do good deeds.
verses.15: (For such is the will of God: to bring about the ignorance of those who are foolish people.)
verses.16: As free beings, not as those who cover up their own evils with freedom, but as slaves of God.
verses.17: Honor everyone; love your brothers and sisters. Fear the God. Respect the king.
verses.18: Those who live under the rule of their masters, filled with fear, are not only subject to the good and kind rulers, but also to those who are cruel and unjust.
verses.19: For this is a gift from God, if anyone can bear the pain of suffering unjustly.
verses.20: For when we sin and commit vices, do we really deserve to be punished? But when we do good and suffer, that is a gift from God.
verses.21: For this very reason, you were chosen: that Christ also suffered for you. You are meant to follow in His footsteps.
verses.22: He did not commit any sins, nor was there any deceit in his mouth.
verses.23: He who is deceived does not resist the deception; he who suffers does not complain. Instead, he gives justice to those who judge him fairly.
verses.24: He who incarnated our sins in his own body, so that we could live according to justice despite our sins. You were terrified by him.
verses.25: For once, you were like sheep being led around by the nose. But now, you have returned to being leaders and overseers over your own souls.
